purpose: Compare observed training reconstruction errors with the test-key-weighted public-candidate error scale. This is not a measured Kaggle test score.
assumption: Conditional on a competition row's matching key, its unknown rent is a uniformly selected record from the corresponding public group, counting duplicate rents with their observed multiplicity.
quantity: Square root of expected MSE under the stated assumption; not the expectation of sample RMSE, and not a confidence interval.
limitations: No competition test labels were accessed, recovered into a labeled test file, or evaluated.
The public leaderboard scores a subset of test rows; the 173.41 calculation weights all 50000 test keys.
The uniform-candidate assumption can fail if competition rows were selected nonuniformly within matching groups.
No claim is made about any team's implementation or its compliance with competition rules.
